requirements.statement: calendar_store/next_event_match shall implement dual-bank 128×23-bit sparse event lists with S0 registered SRAM read, S1 slot==counter qualification in noc_clk; entries sorted by slot; activation only at slot 0 after old-epoch retirement.

acceptance_criteria.description: The BFM fires each active-bank entry exactly at entry.slot after inactive-bank handoff.
Calendar storage is exactly 2×128×23 = 5,888 payload bits per router.

requirements.statement: BG/escape shall use SharedPool-BG vc_buffers with 28 shared flits plus five per-port reserves of 2 (38 total) using the RC→SA→ST pipeline and soft-priority service on non-matching cycles. Calendar never enqueues into the pool. Conservative hard bound is 328 cycles; soft reserve-covered bound is ~160 cycles; soft+pool contention bound is ~188 cycles. H/V credits are 16/20.

acceptance_criteria.description: test_bg_window, test_bg_bound, and test_shared_pool pass with BG_SHARED_POOL_SIZE=28 and BG_PER_PORT_RESERVE=2.
A firing calendar event is never displaced by BG, and calendar payloads never enter vc_buffers.
When the 28 shared slots are exhausted, every port still accepts its two reserve flits.

requirements.statement: CalFork shall atomically expand the calendar-native out_port_mask through cal_fork_expand(); it is not a general FlooNoC stream_fork. watchdog_demote shall release once and emit lossless XY escape packets for remaining leaves into pool/reserves within 2 cycles of available capacity.

acceptance_criteria.description: test_blocked_fork and test_demote_noloss pass using the calendar-native CalFork path.
Each violation releases exactly one reservation and preserves every remaining leaf when capacity exists.

requirements.statement: μArch shall not instantiate combine_unit or DCA. Reduce/allreduce use Tier-A PE handoff; CAL_OP_PE_HANDOFF is forward/tag only.

acceptance_criteria.description: Router context and BFM builds contain no combine_unit or DCA interface.
uarch.md documents combine and DCA as absent.

requirements.statement: Analytic PPA for the μArch shall report crossbar 0.380, buffers 0.139, SparseCal 0.009, CalFork multicast 0.025, control 0.193, and total area ~0.746× with power 0.90× versus IQ-XY. This improves on Arch-A4's 0.822×/0.92×.

acceptance_criteria.description: ppa_analytic_model.py reports total area 0.746× and power 0.90× for the 28+2 CalFork configuration.
The area breakdown is XB=0.380, Buf=0.139, Cal=0.009, MC=0.025, Ctrl=0.193, with no combine component.

requirements.statement: Single noc_clk domain at 2 GHz; one 512-bit flit per granted direction per cycle; H=7 V=9 ramp=1 modeled as link/PE latency, not a second clock. Global slot counter wraps at 1024.

acceptance_criteria.description: clock-domain-map.md lists noc_clk as the sole clock domain and the BFM uses H=7, V=9, and ramp=1.
The BFM replays calendars and reports makespan without a CDC synchronizer.
